limitations: These are compile-loop samples, excluding Nix evaluation, source preparation, test execution and installation.
The workload matches test targets and runtime behavior, but debug settings differ: Cargo dev uses debug=2, Bazel fastbuild debug=0; both use opt-level=0.
Other qualification jobs ran concurrently on the shared host; each sample records load average. These are descriptive baselines, not accepted regression budgets.
The immutable source/configuration paths in the report predate the editor metadata changes committed alongside this harness.
No accache hits were observed; successful admitted misses do not establish a performance benefit.
The Bazel edit loop regresses versus Cargo incremental. No production cutover is authorized by these measurements.
scope: Provenance and limits of the device-family compile-loop baseline
